summary: Style resources: follow existing Ansible docs, ask the community, and consult AP Stylebook, Chicago Manual of Style, Strunk and White, and the Google developer documentation style guide.
questions: Which external style guides does Ansible recommend?

answer_card.title: Style resources
answer_card.answer_md: Follow the existing Ansible docs, ask the community, and consult the AP Stylebook, Chicago Manual of Style, Strunk and White's *Elements of Style*, and the Google developer documentation style guide.
